description: This file implements a registry system for template heuristics used within PyTorch Inductor. It manages registration, retrieval, and overriding of heuristic classes based on device type and operator name, facilitating customizable behavior for different hardware backends like CUDA and ROCm.

methods.name: Any register_template_heuristic( template_name: str, device_type: Union[str, None], register: bool = True, op_name: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Decorator for registering template heuristic classes for specific templates, device types, and optionally operator names.

methods.name: TemplateConfigHeuristics get_template_heuristic( template_name: str, device_type: str, op_name: str )
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of a heuristic class for a specific template, device, and operator, using caching and fallback to default if none found.

methods.name: None|type[TemplateConfigHeuristics] get_registered_heuristic_class( template_name: str, device_type: str, op_name: str )
methods.description: Finds and returns the registered heuristic class for given template, device, and operator combination.

methods.name: None clear_registry()
methods.description: Clears all registered heuristics and caches, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: Iterator[None] override_template_heuristics( device_type: str, template_op_pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], override_heuristic_class: type[TemplateConfigHeuristics] = TemplateConfigHeuristics, )
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily override heuristics for specific template and operator pairs during testing.
